restlet.description: Trigger Map/Reduce scripts and poll their progress over JSON. Primarily called by netsuite-cli via `restlet call`; contract documented in the cp-mr-driver skill. POST {"script","deployment"?,"params"?} submits the MR and returns the task id; GET ?taskid= returns task.checkStatus with stage detail. Deployment audience is Administrator only, since this can start any Map/Reduce in the account.
restlet.name: CP | MR Driver RESTlet
